result:
The REST module reaches `AdministrationService.getGlobalProperty` through one private wrapper in `RestUtil` and through about eight direct call sites in controllers, helpers, and tests. Nothing was modified.

**Production code (most likely affected, best first):**

1. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:71-79` is the private `getGlobalProperty(name, default)` wrapper. It calls `Context.getAdministrationService().getGlobalProperty(propertyName, defaultValue)` at line 74. Every `RestUtil` lookup below goes through it, so any change to the two-argument overload's behaviour affects all of them.
2. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:87-101` is `getDefaultLimit()`, which reads `MAX_RESULTS_DEFAULT_GLOBAL_PROPERTY_NAME` and parses it as an integer. It is the default page-size limit for REST results.
3. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:109-123` is `getAbsoluteLimit()`, which reads `MAX_RESULTS_ABSOLUTE_GLOBAL_PROPERTY_NAME` and parses it the same way.
4. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:222-239` is `getAllowedIps()`, which reads the allowed-IPs property and falls back to an empty list when it is empty. It gates API access.
5. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:612-627` is `setUriPrefix()`, which sets `RestConstants.URI_PREFIX` from the URI-prefix global property at line 614. The URI prefix is used to build links in responses.
6. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/RestUtil.java:816-866` is `wrapErrorResponse(ex, reason)`, which reads the stack-trace-details flag at line 846 and decides whether error bodies include stack traces.
7. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/helper/LayoutTemplateProvider.java:82-87` is `getPopulatedTemplateDefaults(template)`, which reads the layout-defaults global property at line 83.
8. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/VisitConfigurationController2_0.java:55-69` is `getCurrentConfiguration()`, which reads the visit assignment handler at line 64 for the visit configuration endpoint.
9. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/VisitConfigurationController2_0.java:102-106` is `getEnableVisitsValue(...)`, which reads the enable-visits property with a default of `"true"`.
10. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/VisitConfigurationController2_0.java:140-160` is `getVisitTypesToAutoCloseValue(...)`, which reads and parses the visit-types-to-auto-close property at line 142.
11. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/LocaleAndThemeConfigurationController2_0.java:35-45` is `getCurrentConfiguration()`, which reads the default theme and default locale at lines 37-38.
12. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod-common/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/docs/swagger/SwaggerSpecificationCreator.java:173-175` is `toggleLogs(...)`, which checks the Swagger quiet-docs property at line 174 to decide whether to silence logging while generating docs.

**Tests (would break if the behaviour changed, but are not runtime code):**

13. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_9/ObsResource1_9Test.java:63-68` reads the true and false concept global properties and parses them as integers.
14. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/test/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs2_0/NameTemplateController2_0Test.java:63` reads the name-format global property to save and restore it.

Caveats:
- Falkon returned only these call sites; I did not check for indirect callers of `RestUtil.getDefaultLimit`, `getAllowedIps` and the other `RestUtil` helpers. Those callers would also be affected by a change to `RestUtil.getGlobalProperty`.
- The `toggleLogs` and `ObsResource1_9Test` ranges cover only the lines containing the call, not the whole method.
- I did not read the `openmrs-core` definition of `AdministrationService.getGlobalProperty`, so I have not verified what kind of change would alter these call sites.
